zh-CN.title: 置顶消息现在整齐又清楚
items: 置顶列表使用稳定的操作栏，不再因能否取消置顶而左右跳动
仅他人置顶时展示只读图钉，自己参与置顶时提供清晰的取消操作
多人置顶的姓名会自然收起，同时完整保留消息与时间信息

en.title: Pinned messages are now aligned and clear
items: The pinned list now keeps a stable action rail instead of shifting with unpin permissions
Pins created only by others show a quiet read-only mark, while your own pins expose a clear unpin action
Long multi-user attribution truncates gracefully while preserving message and time information
